shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab
horizontal registers/bands stacked one above another
a row of repeated small motifs along an upper band
anthropomorphic figures with raised or extended arms
weathered, damaged stone surface with breaks and pitting
justification: Both are tall, weathered upright stone slabs carved in shallow relief and organised into stacked horizontal registers, with a row of repeated small motifs across an upper band and profile animal and human-like figures below. The rendering, however, is entirely different: A uses few, large, boldly modelled, rounded animal forms against empty ground, while B is dominated by dense, fine, evenly ruled lines of small incised signs beneath a compact figural scene, so the overall impression is one of sparse sculpture versus an inscribed text panel.
